actions.mechanism: Matching file hashes permit grouping; differing license records or creator IDs keep entries separate.
actions.implementation: Create expandable search groups keyed by hash, license-record ID, and creator ID. Display copy counts and folder paths; retain every file identifier.
actions.check: Verify same-key copies condense, identical pixels with different licenses remain separate, and every grouped file remains selectable.
actions.risk: Byte-different encodings remain ungrouped; hash grouping does not establish visual equivalence.

actions.action: Expose intentional version relationships without collapsing variants.
actions.mechanism: Explicit, typed links distinguish crops and annotations from interchangeable copies without inferring intent from resemblance.
actions.implementation: Allow people to record directed “crop of” and “annotated version of” links. Show related-version navigation while keeping variants independently searchable.
actions.check: Link two crops to one original; confirm all three remain independently searchable and links can be corrected or removed.
actions.risk: Incorrect or incomplete links require human correction; never infer license inheritance.

actions.action: Record the exact licensed file each project used.
actions.mechanism: An append-only usage record preserves file identity and license context independently of search presentation or later edits.
actions.implementation: On asset insertion or export, record project ID, file ID, hash, timestamp, and the applicable license-record revision; expose project usage history.
actions.check: Use identical-pixel files with different licenses in separate projects; verify each history retrieves its actual file and recorded license revision.
actions.risk: Untracked imports leave gaps; label missing provenance rather than guessing.

actions.action: Precompute grouping metadata outside the search request.
actions.mechanism: Indexed group keys and counts avoid request-time file inspection or relationship traversal on the first page.
actions.implementation: Add grouping fields to the existing index. Bound first-page queries; fetch expanded members and relationship details only when opened.
actions.check: Benchmark the 12,000-asset index under representative concurrency and cold caches; reject deployment if any tested first-page load reaches one second.
actions.risk: Index capabilities may limit grouping; stale metadata needs reconciliation before release.
